closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin C, easy to build meals around, and helps add volume without much calorie cost, but the biggest weaknesses are low protein amount, low calcium, and low omega 3. It is good for immune support, low-calorie volume, and practical meals because vitamin C and vitamin A gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure, and the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around.
